items.passageEn: Every Sunday, Grandma cooks fish. First, she puts garlic, onion and a few tablespoons of oil in a hot pan. Then she adds the fish and some lemon. My little brother doesn't like cooked fish. He prefers raw fish at Japanese restaurants. But after one bite of Grandma's fish, he asked for more!
items.passageZh: 每個星期天，奶奶都會煮魚。她先把大蒜、洋蔥和幾大匙油放進熱鍋，再放魚和一點檸檬。我弟弟不喜歡煮熟的魚，他比較喜歡日本料理店的生魚片。可是吃了一口奶奶煮的魚之後，他還想再吃！

questions.questionZh: 奶奶先把什麼放進鍋裡？
弟弟吃了一口之後怎麼了？

items.promptZh: 今天市場上的檸檬很便宜。
referenceEn: Lemons are very cheap at the market today.
The lemons at the market are cheap today.
rubricZh: 用 lemon 表示「檸檬」，泛指用複數（例如 lemons）
「很便宜」可寫，例如 very cheap、cheap 等

items.promptZh: 這些蜂蜜是我叔叔送的。
referenceEn: My uncle gave me this honey.
My uncle gave this honey to me.
rubricZh: honey 不可數，不加 s（例如 this honey、the honey 等）
「是我叔叔送的」可寫，例如 My uncle gave me…、is from my uncle 等
